:== mass = f64

:== position = f64

:== velocity_cf = mass -> velocity -> list scalar_force -> (time -> velocity)

:= velocity_cf m v0 fs =
    := f_net = fs |> listm'::sum
    := a0 = f_net / m
    := v t = v0 + a0 * t
    v

:== derivative = (f64 -> f64) -> f64 -> f64

:= derivative dt : derivative =
    \ x t =>
        (x (t + dt / 2) - x (t - dt / 2)) / dt

:== integration = (f64 -> f64) -> f64 -> f64 -> f64

:= integral dt : integration =
    \ f a b =>
        := ^ 루프 t y =
            ? t < b
            ?> 루프 (t + dt) (y + f t * dt)
            |: t, y
        루프 (a + dt / 2) 0
        |> snd

|> _assert_approx_eq None 0.33332500000000004
__assert_approx_eq { expected = 0.33332500000000004 }
:= integral' dt : integration =
    \ f a b =>
        listm'::init_series (a + dt / 2) (b - dt / 2) dt
        |> listm::map (f >> (*) dt)
        |> listm'::sum
test integration_2: passed

integral' 0.1 math::square 0 1
|> _assert_approx_eq None (integral 0.1 math::square 0 1)
__assert_approx_eq { expected = 0.33249999999999996 }
:= integral'' dt : integration =
    \ f x y =>
        am'::init_series (x + dt / 2) (y - dt / 2) dt
        |> \ x => array x : array _
        |> arraym::map (f >> (*) dt)
        |> am'::sum

|> _assert_approx_eq None (integral 0.01 math::square 0 1)

:= anti_derivative dt v0 a t =
    v0 + integral' dt a 0 t

:== velocity_ft = mass -> velocity -> list (time -> scalar_force) -> (time -> velocity)

:= velocity_ft dt : velocity_ft =
    \ m v0 fs =>
        := f_net t = fs |> listm::map (\ f => f t) |> listm'::sum
        := a t = f_net t / m
        anti_derivative dt v0 a

:== position_ft = mass -> position -> velocity -> list (time -> scalar_force) -> (time -> position)

:= position_ft dt : position_ft =
    \ m x0 v0 fs =>
        velocity_ft dt m v0 fs
        |> anti_derivative dt x0

:= pedal_coast (t : time) : scalar_force =
    := t_cycle = 20
    := n_complete : i32 = t / t_cycle |> conv
    := remainder = t - conv n_complete * t_cycle
    ? remainder > 0 && remainder < 10
    ?> 10
    |: 0

:= newton_second_v m fs v0 =
    fs |> listm::map (\ f => f v0) |> listm'::sum |> \ x => x / m

:= update_velocity dt m fs v0 =
    v0 + newton_second_v m fs v0 * dt

:= velocity_fv dt m v0 fs t =
    stream::iterate (update_velocity dt m fs) v0
    |> stream::try_item (t / dt |> math::round |> abs)
    |> optionm'::default_value 0

:= f_air drag rho area v =
    -drag * rho * area * abs v * v / 2

:= newton_second_tv m fs (t, v0) =
    := f_net = fs |> listm::map (\ f => f (t, v0)) |> listm'::sum
    := acc = f_net / m
    1, acc

:= update_tv dt m fs (t, v0) =
    := dtdt, dvdt = newton_second_tv m fs (t, v0)
    t + dtdt * dt, v0 + dvdt * dt

:= velocity_ftv dt m tv0 fs t =
    stream::iterate (~~ update_tv dt m fs) tv0
    |> stream::try_item (t / dt |> math::round |> abs)
    |> optionm::map snd
    |> optionm'::default_value 0

:= pedal_coast_air_velocity () =
    velocity_ftv 0.1 20 (dyn (0, 0)) [ \ (t, _) => pedal_coast t; \ (_, v) => f_air 2 1.225 0.5 v ]

:! state_1d = time * position * velocity
:! rrr = f64 * f64 * f64

:= newton_second_1d m fs (state_1d (t, x0, v0)) =
    := f_net = fs |> listm::map (\ f => f (state_1d (t, x0, v0))) |> listm'::sum
    := acc = f_net / m
    rrr (1f64, v0, acc)

:= euler_1d dt deriv (state_1d (t0, x0, v0) &= t) =
    := (rrr (_, _, dvdt)) = deriv t
    := t1 = t0 + dt
    := x1 = x0 + v0 * dt
    := v1 = v0 + dvdt * dt
    state_1d (t1, x1, v1)

:= update_txv dt m fs =
    newton_second_1d m fs |> euler_1d dt

:= states_txv dt m txv0 fs =
    seq::iterate_ (update_txv dt m fs) txv0

:= velocity_1d sts t =
    := (state_1d (t0, _, _)) = sts 0
    := (state_1d (t1, _, _)) = sts 1
    := dt = t1 - t0
    := num_steps = t / dt |> math::round |> abs
    := (state_1d (_, _, v0)) = sts num_steps
    v0

:= velocity_ftxv dt m txv0 fs =
    states_txv dt m txv0 fs |> velocity_1d

:= position_1d sts t =
    := (state_1d (t0, _, _)) = sts 0
    := (state_1d (t1, _, _)) = sts 1
    := dt = t1 - t0
    := num_steps = t / dt |> math::round |> abs
    := (state_1d (_, x0, _)) = sts num_steps
    x0

:= position_ftxv dt m txv0 fs =
    states_txv dt m txv0 fs |> position_1d

:= spring_force k (state_1d (_, x0, _)) =
    -k * x0

:= damped_ho_forces () =
    [
        spring_force 0.8
        \ (state_1d (_, _, v0)) => f_air 2 1.225 (pi * math::square 0.02) v0
        \ _ => -0.0027 * 9.80665
    ]

:= pingpong_position t = position_ftxv 0.001 0.0027 (state_1d (0, 0.1, 0)) (damped_ho_forces ()) t

:== update_function s = s -> s

:== differential_equation s ds = s -> ds

:== numerical_method s ds = differential_equation s ds -> update_function s

:= solver method =
    method >> seq::iterate

:= solver' method =
    method >> seq::iterate'

:= solver_ method =
    method >> seq::iterate_

:= euler_cromer_1d dt deriv (state_1d (t0, x0, v0) &= t) =
    := (rrr (_, _, dvdt)) = deriv t
    := t1 = t0 + dt
    := v1 = v0 + dvdt * dt
    := x1 = x0 + v1 * dt
    state_1d (t1, x1, v1)

:= update_txv_ec dt m fs =
    euler_cromer_1d dt (newton_second_1d m fs)

:? (+++) ds : ds -> ds -> ds
:? scale ds : f64 -> ds -> ds

:+ (+++) rrr = \ (rrr (dtdt0, dxdt0, dvdt0)) (rrr (dtdt1, dxdt1, dvdt1)) =>
    rrr (dtdt0 + dtdt1, dxdt0 + dxdt1, dvdt0 + dvdt1)

:+ scale rrr = \ w (rrr (dtdt0, dxdt0, dvdt0)) =>
    rrr (w * dtdt0, w * dxdt0, w * dvdt0)

:? shift s : \* ds. f64 -> ds -> s -> s

:+ shift state_1d = \ dt ds (state_1d (t, x, v)) =>
    := dtdt, dxdt, dvdt =
        ~>
            ?= ds ?|
            | rrr x => x
            | state_1d x => x
    state_1d (t + dtdt * dt, x + dxdt * dt, v + dvdt * dt)

:= euler dt deriv st0 =
    shift dt (deriv st0) st0

:= runge_kutta_4 dt deriv st0 =
    := m0 = deriv st0
    := m1 = deriv (shift (dt / 2) m0 st0)
    := m2 = deriv (shift (dt / 2) m1 st0)
    := m3 = deriv (shift dt m2 st0)
    shift (dt / 6) (m0 +++ m1 +++ m1 +++ m2 +++ m2 +++ m3) st0

:= exponential (_, x0, v0) =
    1f64, v0, x0

:= of_state_1d (state_1d (t, x, v)) =
    t, x, v

:== vec_derivative = (f64 -> vec) -> f64 -> vec

:= vec_derivative dt : vec_derivative =
    \ v t =>
        (v (t + dt / 2) ^-^ v (t - dt / 2)) ^/ dt

:! particle_state =
    {
        mass : f64
        charge : f64
        time : f64
        pos_vec : vec
        velocity : vec
    }

:= default_particle_state () : particle_state =
    particle_state {
        mass = 1
        charge = 0
        time = 0
        pos_vec = zero_vec ()
        velocity = zero_vec ()
    }

:== one_body_force = particle_state -> vec

:! d_particle_state =
    {
        dmdt : f64
        dqdt : f64
        dtdt : f64
        drdt : vec
        dvdt : vec
    }

:= net_force (fs : list one_body_force) (st : particle_state) : vec = fs |> listm::map (\ f => f st) |> sum_vec

:= rate_with (st : particle_state) (dvdt : vec) : d_particle_state =
    d_particle_state {
        dmdt = 0
        dqdt = 0
        dtdt = 1
        drdt = st::velocity
        dvdt = dvdt
    }

:= newton_second_ps (fs : list one_body_force) (st : particle_state) : d_particle_state =
    rate_with st (net_force fs st ^/ st::mass)

:= earth_surface_gravity (st : particle_state) =
    := g = 9.80665
    -st::mass * g *^ k_hat ()

:= air_resistance drag rho area (st : particle_state) =
    -0.5 * drag * rho * area * magnitude st::velocity *^ st::velocity

:= cromer_moved dt (v' : vec) (particle_state st) : particle_state =
    particle_state { st ?| time = st::time + dt; pos_vec = st::pos_vec ^+^ v' ^* dt; velocity = v' }

:= euler_cromer_ps dt (deriv : particle_state -> d_particle_state) (particle_state st) =
    := dst : d_particle_state = deriv (particle_state st)
    cromer_moved dt (st::velocity ^+^ dst::dvdt ^* dt) (particle_state st)

:+ (+++) d_particle_state = \ (a : d_particle_state) b =>
    d_particle_state {
        dmdt = a::dmdt + b::dmdt
        dqdt = a::dqdt + b::dqdt
        dtdt = a::dtdt + b::dtdt
        drdt = a::drdt ^+^ b::drdt
        dvdt = a::dvdt ^+^ b::dvdt
    }

:+ scale d_particle_state = \ w (dps : d_particle_state) =>
    d_particle_state {
        dmdt = w * dps::dmdt
        dqdt = w * dps::dqdt
        dtdt = w * dps::dtdt
        drdt = w *^ dps::drdt
        dvdt = w *^ dps::dvdt
    }

:= shifted dt (dps : d_particle_state) (particle_state st) : particle_state =
    particle_state { st ?|
        time = st::time + dps::dtdt * dt
        pos_vec = st::pos_vec ^+^ dps::drdt ^* dt
        velocity = st::velocity ^+^ dps::dvdt ^* dt
    }

:+ shift particle_state = \ dt dps (particle_state st) =>
    := (d_particle_state dps) =
        ~>
            ?= dps ?|
            | d_particle_state _ => dps
    shifted dt (d_particle_state dps) (particle_state st)

:= states_ps (method : numerical_method particle_state d_particle_state) : _ -> _ -> i32 -> particle_state =
    newton_second_ps >> method >> seq::iterate_

:= z_ge0 sts =
    sts
    |> seq::take_while_ \ (particle_state st) _ => st::pos_vec::z >= 0

:= trajectory sts =
    sts |> listm::map \ (particle_state st) => st::pos_vec::y, st::pos_vec::z

:= update_ps (method : numerical_method particle_state d_particle_state) =
    newton_second_ps >> method

:= step_count (states : i32 -> particle_state) t =
    := dt = (states 1)::time - (states 0)::time
    t / dt |> math::round |> abs

:= position_ps (method : numerical_method particle_state d_particle_state) fs st t =
    := st1 = solver' method (newton_second_ps fs) st (step_count (states_ps method fs st) t)
    st1::pos_vec

:= sun_gravity (st : particle_state) : vec =
    := big_g = 0.0000000000667408
    := sun_mass = 1988480000000000000000000000000
    -big_g * sun_mass * st::mass *^ st::pos_vec ^/ magnitude st::pos_vec ** 3

:= wind_force v_wind drag rho area (st : particle_state) =
    := v_rel = st::velocity ^-^ v_wind
    -0.5 * drag * rho * area * magnitude v_rel *^ v_rel

:= rock_state () =
    := (particle_state default_particle_state') = default_particle_state ()
    particle_state { default_particle_state' ?|
        mass = 2
        velocity = vec 3 0 4
    }

:= halley_update dt =
    update_ps (euler_cromer_ps dt) [ sun_gravity ]

:= halley_initial () =
    := (particle_state default_particle_state') = default_particle_state ()
    particle_state { default_particle_state' ?|
        mass = 220000000000000
        pos_vec = 87660000000 *^ i_hat ()
        velocity = 54569 *^ j_hat ()
    }

:= baseball_forces () =
    := area = pi * (0.074 / 2) ** 2
    [
        earth_surface_gravity
        air_resistance 0.3 1.225 area
    ]

:= baseball_initial v0 theta_deg =
    := theta_rad = theta_deg * pi / 180
    particle_state {
        mass = 0.145
        charge = 0
        time = 0
        pos_vec = zero_vec ()
        velocity = vec 0 (v0 * cos theta_rad) (v0 * sin theta_rad)
    }

:= baseball_trajectory dt v0 theta_deg =
    states_ps (euler_cromer_ps dt) (baseball_forces ()) (baseball_initial v0 theta_deg)
    >> Some
    |> z_ge0
    |> trajectory

:= baseball_range dt v0 theta_deg =
    baseball_trajectory dt v0 theta_deg
    |> listm::fold (\ _ (y, _) => y) 0

:= relativity_ps fs (st : particle_state) =
    := f_net = net_force fs st
    := u = st::velocity ^/ 299792458
    rate_with st (sqrt (1 - (u <.> u)) *^ (f_net ^-^ (f_net <.> u) *^ u) ^/ st::mass)

:= curve_arrays (xs, ys) = (xs |> listm'::box |> listm'::to_array'), (ys |> listm'::box |> listm'::to_array')

:= seconds_per_year () = 365.25 * 24 * 60 * 60

:= year_points states =
    := year = seconds_per_year ()
    states >> Some
    |> seq::take_while_ \ (particle_state st) (_ : i32) => st::time <= year
    |> listm::map \ (particle_state st) => st::time / year, st::velocity::x / 299792458
    |> listm'::unzip

:= constant_force_start () =
    := (particle_state st) = default_particle_state ()
    particle_state { st ?| mass = 1 }

:= year_curve method deriv = solver_ method deriv (constant_force_start ()) |> year_points |> curve_arrays

:~ ^ numbers_from (xs : array_base f64) (i : i32) : list string =
    ? i >= am'::length_base xs ?> [] |: sm'::format_debug (am'::index_base i xs) :: numbers_from xs (i + 1i32)

:= numbers_json (xs : array_base f64) : string =
    sm'::concat_list "" [ "["; numbers_from xs 0i32 |> sm'::concat_list ", "; "]" ]

:= series_json ((label, xs, ys) : string * array_base f64 * array_base f64) : string =
    sm'::concat_list "" [ "["; json::quote label; ", "; numbers_json xs; ", "; numbers_json ys; "]" ]

:== chart = string * string * string * array (string * array_base f64 * array_base f64)

:= chart_json ((caption, x, y, series) : chart) : string =
    sm'::concat_list "" [
        "["; json::quote caption; ", "; json::quote x; ", "; json::quote y; ", ["
        series |> am'::map' series_json |> sm'::join' ", "
        "]]"
    ]

:= show_chart chart : () =
    console::write_line (
        sm'::concat_list "" [
            "SPIRAL_CELLS_DISPLAY_BEGIN\napplication/vnd.spiral.plot+json\n"
            chart_json chart
            "\nSPIRAL_CELLS_DISPLAY_END"
        ]
    )

:~ ^ charts_from (cs : array_base chart) (i : i32)
    : list string
    =
    ? i >= am'::length_base cs ?> [] |: chart_json (am'::index_base i cs) :: charts_from cs (i + 1i32)

:= show_frames (charts : array_base chart) : () =
    console::write_line (
        sm'::concat_list "" [
            "SPIRAL_CELLS_DISPLAY_BEGIN\napplication/vnd.spiral.plot-frames+json\n["
            charts_from charts 0i32 |> sm'::concat_list ", "
            "]\nSPIRAL_CELLS_DISPLAY_END"
        ]
    )

:= constant_force_chart newton_x newton_y relativity_y =
    "response to a constant force",
    "time (years)",
    "velocity (multiples of c)",
    ;[
        "newtonian", newton_x, newton_y
        "relativistic", newton_x, relativity_y
    ]

:= constant_force_chart_of method forces =
    := newton_x, newton_y = year_curve method (newton_second_ps forces)
    := _, relativity_y = year_curve method (relativity_ps forces)
    constant_force_chart newton_x newton_y relativity_y

test relativity_ps_2: passed 
///- --test --symbol

:= ~method = runge_kutta_4 0.000000001
proton_chart_of method [ uniform_lorentz_force (zero_vec ()) (k_hat ()) ] |> show_chart
:== force_vector = vec
:== two_body_force = particle_state -> particle_state -> force_vector

:| force =
    | ExternalForce : i32 * one_body_force
    | InternalForce : i32 * i32 * two_body_force

:! multi_particle_state_l = list particle_state

:! d_multi_particle_state_l = list d_particle_state

:= internal_force_on n sts n0 n1 f_two_body =
    ? n = n0
    ?> f_two_body (sts |> listm'::item n1)
    |? n = n1
    ?> f_two_body (sts |> listm'::item n0)
    |: \ _ => zero_vec ()

:= force_on n sts force =
    ?= force ?|
    | ExternalForce (n0, f_one_body) =>
        ? n = n0
        ?> f_one_body
        |: \ _ => zero_vec ()
    | InternalForce (n0, n1, f_two_body) => internal_force_on n sts n0 n1 f_two_body

:= forces_on n (multi_particle_state_l sts) fs =
    fs |> listm::map (force_on n sts)

:= newton_second_mps fs (multi_particle_state_l sts) : d_multi_particle_state_l =
    := deriv (n, st) =
        newton_second_ps (forces_on n (multi_particle_state_l sts) fs) st
    sts |> listm'::indexed |> listm::map deriv |> d_multi_particle_state_l

:= update_mps_l (method : numerical_method multi_particle_state_l d_multi_particle_state_l) =
    newton_second_mps >> method

:+ (+++) d_multi_particle_state_l = \ (d_multi_particle_state_l dsts1) (d_multi_particle_state_l dsts2) =>
    d_multi_particle_state_l (listm'::zip_with_ (+++) dsts1 dsts2)

:+ shift multi_particle_state_l = \ dt dsts (multi_particle_state_l sts) =>
    := (d_multi_particle_state_l dsts) =
        ~>
            ?= dsts ?|
            | d_multi_particle_state_l _ => dsts
    listm'::zip_with_ (shift dt) dsts sts |> multi_particle_state_l

:= central_force f (particle_state st1) (particle_state st2) =
    := r1 = st1::pos_vec
    := r2 = st2::pos_vec
    := r21 = r2 ^-^ r1
    := r21mag = magnitude r21
    f r21mag *^ r21 ^/ r21mag

:= billiard_force k re =
    := f r =
        ? r >= re
        ?> 0
        |: -k * (r - re)
    central_force f

:+ scale d_multi_particle_state_l = \ w (d_multi_particle_state_l dsts) =>
    d_multi_particle_state_l (dsts |> listm::map (scale w))

:= cromer_position dt ((particle_state st0), (particle_state st1)) =
    particle_state { st1 ?| pos_vec = st0::pos_vec ^+^ st1::velocity ^* dt }

:== mps_method_l = numerical_method multi_particle_state_l d_multi_particle_state_l

:= euler_cromer_mps_l dt : mps_method_l =
    \ deriv mpst0 =>
        := (multi_particle_state_l sts0) = mpst0
        := (multi_particle_state_l sts1) = euler dt deriv mpst0
        sts1 |> listm'::zip_ sts0 |> listm::map (cromer_position dt) |> multi_particle_state_l

:= states_mps_l (method : numerical_method multi_particle_state_l d_multi_particle_state_l) =
    newton_second_mps >> method >> seq::iterate_

:= kinetic_energy (particle_state st) =
    := m = st::mass
    := v = magnitude st::velocity
    0.5 * m * v ** 2

:= system_ke_l (multi_particle_state_l sts) =
    sts |> listm::map kinetic_energy |> listm'::sum

:= linear_spring_pe k re (particle_state st1) (particle_state st2) =
    := r1 = st1::pos_vec
    := r2 = st2::pos_vec
    := r21 = r2 ^-^ r1
    := r21mag = magnitude r21
    k * (r21mag - re) ** 2 / 2

:= earth_surface_gravity_pe (particle_state st) =
    := g = 9.80665
    := m = st::mass
    := z = st::pos_vec::z
    m * g * z

:= spring_pair_pe st0 st1 = linear_spring_pe 100 0.5 (default_particle_state ()) st0 + linear_spring_pe 100 0.5 st0 st1

:= two_springs_pe (multi_particle_state_l sts) =
    := st0 = sts |> listm'::item 0i32
    := st1 = sts |> listm'::item 1i32
    spring_pair_pe st0 st1 + earth_surface_gravity_pe st0 + earth_surface_gravity_pe st1

:= two_springs_me mpst =
    system_ke_l mpst + two_springs_pe mpst

:= ball_radius () = 0.03

:= billiard_forces_l k =
    [ InternalForce (0, 1, billiard_force k (2 * ball_radius ())) ]

:= billiard_update n_method k dt =
    update_mps_l (n_method dt) (billiard_forces_l k)

:= billiard_ball (at : vec) (velocity : vec) : particle_state =
    := (particle_state st) = default_particle_state ()
    particle_state { st ?| mass = 0.160; pos_vec = at; velocity = velocity }

:= billiard_balls () : list particle_state =
    [ billiard_ball (zero_vec ()) (0.2 *^ i_hat ()); billiard_ball (i_hat () ^+^ 0.02 *^ j_hat ()) (zero_vec ()) ]

:= billiard_initial_l () = multi_particle_state_l (billiard_balls ())

:= billiard_states_l ~n_method k dt =
    states_mps_l (n_method dt) (billiard_forces_l k) (billiard_initial_l ())

:= billiard_states_finite_l n_method k dt =
    billiard_states_l n_method k dt
    >> Some
    |> seq::take_while_ (\ (multi_particle_state_l mpst) (_ : i32) =>
        (mpst |> listm'::item 0i32)::time <= 10
    )

:= momentum (particle_state st) =
    := m = st::mass
    := v = st::velocity
    m *^ v

:= system_p_l (multi_particle_state_l sts) =
    sts |> listm::map momentum |> sum_vec

:= ke_chart ec_x ec_y rk4_x rk4_y =
    "system kinetic energy versus time",
    "time (s)",
    "system kinetic energy (j)",
    ;[
        "euler-cromer", ec_x, ec_y
        "runge-kutta 4", rk4_x, rk4_y
    ]

:= ke_point_l (mpst : list particle_state) = (mpst |> listm'::item 0i32)::time, system_ke_l (multi_particle_state_l mpst)

:= ke_curve_l n_method =
    billiard_states_finite_l n_method 30 0.03
    |> listm::map \ (multi_particle_state_l mpst) => ke_point_l mpst
    |> listm'::unzip
    |> curve_arrays

:= linear_spring k re (particle_state st1) (particle_state st2) =
    := r1 = st1::pos_vec
    := r2 = st2::pos_vec
    := r21 = r2 ^-^ r1
    := r21mag = magnitude r21
    -k * (r21mag - re) *^ r21 ^/ r21mag

:= fixed_linear_spring k re r1 =
    := (particle_state default_particle_state') = default_particle_state ()
    linear_spring k re (particle_state { default_particle_state' ?| pos_vec = r1 })

:= string_springs () =
    listm'::init_series 0 59 1 |> listm::map \ n => InternalForce (n, n + 1, linear_spring 5384 0)

:= forces_string_l () =
    [
        ExternalForce (0, fixed_linear_spring 5384 0 (zero_vec ()))
        ExternalForce (63, fixed_linear_spring 5384 0 (0.65 *^ i_hat ()))
    ]
    ++ string_springs ()

:= string_update_l dt =
    update_mps_l (runge_kutta_4 dt) (forces_string_l ())

:= string_ball (x : f64) (y : f64) : particle_state =
    := (particle_state st) = default_particle_state ()
    particle_state { st ?|
        mass = 0.0008293 * 0.65 / 64
        pos_vec = x *^ i_hat () ^+^ y *^ j_hat ()
        velocity = zero_vec ()
    }

:= overtone_y (n : i32) (x : f64) : f64 = 0.005 * sin (conv n * pi * x / 0.65)

:= string_initial_overtone_l n =
    listm'::init_series 0.01 0.64 0.01
    |> listm::map \ x => string_ball x (overtone_y n x)
    |> multi_particle_state_l

:= pluck_y (x : f64) : f64 =
    := n = ? x <= 0.51 ?> 0 |: 0.65
    0.005 / (0.51 - n) * (x - n)

:= string_initial_pluck_l () =
    listm'::init_series 0.01 0.64 0.01
    |> listm::map \ x => string_ball x (pluck_y x)
    |> multi_particle_state_l

:= string_positions_l sts =
    [ zero_vec () ] ++ (sts |> listm::map (\ (particle_state st) => st::pos_vec)) ++ [ 0.65 *^ i_hat () ]

:= string_frame_l initial_state (_ : f64) =
    := (multi_particle_state_l sts) = seq::iterate' (string_update_l 0.000025) initial_state |> \ f => f 0f64
    string_positions_l sts |> listm::map (\ r => r::x, r::y) |> listm'::unzip |> curve_arrays

:= string_frames_l () =
    := ~frames = listm'::init_series 0 9 1f64
    := initial_state = string_initial_overtone_l 3i32
    frames |> listm::map (string_frame_l initial_state) |> listm'::box |> listm'::to_array'

:! multi_particle_state_s = stream::stream particle_state

:! d_multi_particle_state_s = stream::stream d_particle_state

:= internal_force_on_s n s n0 n1 f_two_body =
    ? n = n0
    ?> s |> stream::try_item n1 |> optionm::map f_two_body
    |? n = n1
    ?> s |> stream::try_item n0 |> optionm::map f_two_body
    |: None
    |> optionm'::default_value \ _ => zero_vec ()

:= force_on_s n s force =
    ?= force ?|
    | ExternalForce (n0, f_one_body) =>
        ? n = n0
        ?> f_one_body
        |: \ _ => zero_vec ()
    | InternalForce (n0, n1, f_two_body) => internal_force_on_s n s n0 n1 f_two_body

:= forces_on_s n (multi_particle_state_s sts) fs =
    fs
    |> listm::map (force_on_s n sts)

:= newton_second_mps_s fs ((multi_particle_state_s sts) &= mpst) =
    := deriv (n, st) =
        newton_second_ps (forces_on_s n mpst fs) st
    sts |> stream::indexed |> stream::map deriv |> d_multi_particle_state_s

:= update_mps_s (method : numerical_method multi_particle_state_s d_multi_particle_state_s) =
    newton_second_mps_s >> method

:= stream_shifted dt (dsts : stream::stream d_particle_state) (sts : stream::stream particle_state) =
    (dsts, sts)
    ||> stream::zip_with (shift dt)
    |> stream::memoize
    |> \ x => x ()
    |> multi_particle_state_s

:+ shift multi_particle_state_s = \ dt dsts (multi_particle_state_s sts) =>
    := (d_multi_particle_state_s dsts) =
        ~>
            ?= dsts ?|
            | d_multi_particle_state_s _ => dsts
    stream_shifted dt dsts sts

:+ (+++) d_multi_particle_state_s =
    \ (d_multi_particle_state_s dsts1) (d_multi_particle_state_s dsts2) =>
        (dsts1, dsts2)
        ||> stream::zip_with (+++)
        |> d_multi_particle_state_s

:+ scale d_multi_particle_state_s = \ w (d_multi_particle_state_s dsts) =>
    dsts
    |> stream::map (scale w)
    |> d_multi_particle_state_s

:== mps_method_s = numerical_method multi_particle_state_s d_multi_particle_state_s

:= euler_cromer_mps_s dt : mps_method_s =
    \ deriv ((multi_particle_state_s sts0) &= mpst0) =>
        := (multi_particle_state_s sts1) = euler dt deriv mpst0
        (sts0, sts1) ||> stream::zip |> stream::map (cromer_position dt) |> multi_particle_state_s

:= memoized_into next (multi_particle_state_s y) =
    y |> stream::memoize |> (\ thunk => thunk ()) |> multi_particle_state_s |> next

:= states_mps_s (method : numerical_method multi_particle_state_s d_multi_particle_state_s) =
    newton_second_mps_s >> method >> memoized_into >> seq::iterate'

:= system_ke_s (multi_particle_state_s sts) =
    sts
    |> stream::map kinetic_energy
    |> stream::sum

:= billiard_forces_s k =
    [ InternalForce (0i32, 1, billiard_force k (2 * ball_radius ())) ]

:= billiard_initial_s () = billiard_balls () |> stream::from_list |> multi_particle_state_s

:= billiard_states_s ~n_method k dt =
    states_mps_s (n_method dt) (billiard_forces_s k) (billiard_initial_s ())

:= early_billiards_s (multi_particle_state_s mpst) (_ : i32) : bool =
    ?= mpst |> stream::try_item 0i32 ?|
    | Some st => st::time <= 10
    | None => !-

:= billiard_states_finite_s n_method k dt =
    billiard_states_s n_method k dt >> Some |> seq::take_while_ early_billiards_s

:= system_p_s (multi_particle_state_s sts) =
    sts
    |> stream::map momentum
    |> stream::fold (^+^) (zero_vec ())

:= ke_point_s (mpst : stream::stream particle_state) =
    mpst |> stream::try_item 0i32 |> optionm::map \ st => st::time, system_ke_s (multi_particle_state_s mpst)

:= ke_curve_s n_method =
    billiard_states_finite_s n_method 30 0.03
    |> listm::map \ (multi_particle_state_s mpst) => ke_point_s mpst
    |> listm'::choose id
    |> listm'::unzip
    |> curve_arrays
